# Verifies initial-sync of declarative bindings: text(value=name) where
# name="World" produces a span whose textContent is seeded by the script
# without user interaction. Tests the legacy g.updates initOnly path.
#
# Legacy pipeline emits:
#   - state object: let state = {name: "World"};
#   - per-node updater: function $u__n0_text() { __n0.textContent = state.name; }
#   - "Initial sync" comment + call: $u__n0_text();
# These are the g.updates registry's job; Plan D Task 10+ migrates them.

sngl compile --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# State initialization with the var's initial value.
grep 'state = {name: "World"}' out/index.html

# Per-node updater function emitted from g.updates.
grep '\$u__n0_text' out/index.html
grep '__n0.textContent = state.name' out/index.html

# Initial sync section calls each updater once at script load.
grep 'Initial sync' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
output { none { html } }

component main {
    var name = "World"
    text(value=name)
}
